```{r import libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```

## Read in 2011 Census Data

```{r}
census <- read_xls("raws/census2011.xls", sheet = "QS203EW_Numbers", range = "A11:CD464") %>%
  filter(!is.na(`Area code`)) %>%
  rename(Region = `Area name`, County = `...3`, `Local authority` = `...4`) %>%
  fill(Region, .direction = "down") %>%
  group_by(Region) %>%
  fill(County, .direction = "down") %>%
  ungroup()
```

## Read in 2019 and 2021 APS Data

```{r read in aps2019}
aps2019 <- read.delim("raws/UKDA-8665-tab/tab/apsh_jd19_eul.tab", header = TRUE) %>%
  select(AGE, SEX, GOR9D, CRYOX7_EUL_Sub, CAMEYR, CAMEYR2, HOURPAY, WRKING, QRTR, PHHWTA18)
```

```{r read in aps2021}
aps2021 <- read.delim("raws/UKDA-9021-tab/tab/apsh_jd21_eul_phhwta22.tab", header = TRUE) %>%
  select(AGE, SEX, GOR9D, CRYOX7_EUL_Sub, CAMEYR, CAMEYR2, HOURPAY, WRKING, QRTR, PHHWTA20)
```

## Data Decoding for APS

```{r}
decode_aps <- function(aps) {
  aps_decoded <- aps %>%
    rename(
      REGIONCODE = GOR9D,
      BIRTHCTRY = CRYOX7_EUL_Sub,
      QTRJOINED = QRTR, # Quarter they joined survey
      ) %>%
    mutate(
      across(where(is.numeric), ~ na_if(., -9)),
      across(where(is.numeric), ~ na_if(., -8)),
      REGION = case_when(
        REGIONCODE == "E12000001" ~ "North East",
        REGIONCODE == "E12000002" ~ "North West",
        REGIONCODE == "E12000003" ~ "Yorkshire and The Humber",
        REGIONCODE == "E12000004" ~ "East Midlands",
        REGIONCODE == "E12000005" ~ "West Midlands",
        REGIONCODE == "E12000006" ~ "East of England",
        REGIONCODE == "E12000007" ~ "London",
        REGIONCODE == "E12000008" ~ "South East",
        REGIONCODE == "E12000009" ~ "South West",
        REGIONCODE == "S99999999" ~ "Scotland",
        REGIONCODE == "W99999999" ~ "Wales"),
      SEX_LABEL = factor(SEX, levels = c(1, 2), labels = c("Male", "Female")),
      BIRTHCTRY_LABEL = factor(
        BIRTHCTRY,
        levels = 1:15,
        labels = c(
          "UK", "EU15", "EU8", "EU2", "Other EU", "Other Europe", "Middle East and Central Asia",
          "East Asia", "South Asia", "South East Asia", "Sub-Saharan Africa", "North Africa",
          "North America", "Central and South America", "Oceania")),
      WRKING_LABEL = factor(WRKING, levels = c(1, 2), labels = c("Yes", "No")),
      QTRJOINED_LABEL = factor(QTRJOINED, levels = 1:4, 
                               labels = c("Jan-Mar", "Apr-Jun", "Jul-Sep", "Oct-Dec"))
    )
  return(aps_decoded)
}
```

```{r}
aps2019_decoded <- decode_aps(aps2019)
aps2021_decoded <- decode_aps(aps2021)
```

```{r}
write.csv(aps2019_decoded, "data/aps2019_shrunk_decoded.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(aps2021_decoded, "data/aps2021_shrunk_decoded.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
